name: CM-8 'Ares' Crew Capsule (AX-cmd-01) -- modern interior (option A)
frame: Godot Y-up, metres; same origin as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up

gravity.note: launch/entry: crew reclined 60 deg in the seats; on orbit zero-g

exterior_hide_note: none needed: the interior adds its own inner panes; window_glass stays (optional hide listed in cmd11_iva.json)

hatch_door_1.note: outward-opening side hatch, hinge on the +X edge (outer face). Rotate together with the exterior mesh hatch_door_1 about node_hatch_door_1_hinge.

hatch_door_2.note: docking hatch opens down into the cabin, hinge on the +Y (aft) edge

console.note: swing-down three-screen console: stowed = swung up/aft against the upper aft wall above the crew heads

mq02_1_legrest.note: leg rest swings back 90 deg under the seat pan (between the frame rails) for egress, clearing the side-hatch keep-out

mq01_1_legrest.note: leg rest swings back 90 deg under the seat pan (between the frame rails) for egress, clearing the side-hatch keep-out

mq01_1_keypad.note: swing-in keypad: turns about the armrest post (spine axis); stowed = parked forward of the right armrest, clear of the lap

eqm13_1_extinguisher.note: lift 0.03 m, then pull out along axis
